protocol: One fixed search query per question; get_note only for note_ids in that query's results. Answer solely from those results/readbacks, cite note_id and revision, distinguish planned from implemented, explicitly abstain if evidence is insufficient. No follow-up search or expected-source injection. Fresh fork_turns=none responder for each mode with inherited model/reasoning; sampling parameters not exposed by Codex. Query choices fixed before baseline, including short lexical queries and natural paraphrases. Compare same queries, limit and instructions.

rubric.relevance: precision@5: relevant returned note/chunk count divided by actual results count (0 for empty); relevance requires supporting a checked fact, not merely navigation links
rubric.coverage: unique expected note_ids retrieved / expected note_ids count
rubric.answer: each checked fact 0 absent/wrong, 0.5 partial, 1 explicit and supported; normalized mean
rubric.unsupported: count factual assertions unsupported by retrieved excerpts or allowed readbacks; abstention is not hallucination
